biod: Add bio_wash binary to reset entropy This CL introduces a bio_wash program, which clears & re-initializes any internal crypto entropy/secret of the biometric managers which might be used for encrypting data handled by the corresponding sensor. Currently, only the CrosFpBiometricsManager's ResetEntropy() function is called, but additional BiometricsManager instances can be added. The bio_wash command is intended to be invoked only during powerwash and other scenarios where we clobber the stateful partition. BUG=b:117908009 TEST=1. Build and execute manually. 2. Make addition to run script during power wash. Check that powerwash isn't broken. shellcheck: Allow local in POSIX scripts Officially, local isn't allowed in POSIX shell scripts, so shellcheck warns about it under SC2039. All the shells we use actually allow it and we make use of it, so we don't want to warn about it. An upstream discussion was started at https://github.com/koalaman/shellcheck/issues/1341, but until that's resolved, we can locally patch out the check.
